channel.title: GetMacros Nutrition Guides
channel.description: Healthy fast-food comparisons, macro tools and practical nutrition guides.

item.title: Are Diet Drinks Bad for You? | GetMacros
item.description: Are diet drinks bad for you? Separate sweetener safety, weight-control evidence and practical drink choices without treating every can as good or bad.

item.title: Healthy fast food: which restaurant fits your goal? | GetMacros
item.description: Compare real orders for protein, calories, fiber and portion size. The best choice depends on what you want from your next meal.

item.title: Body recomposition: can you lose fat and build muscle? | GetMacros
item.description: Body recomposition means losing body fat while gaining muscle. It can happen, but progress is gradual and the scale may not show the full change.

item.title: Should You Eat the Same Calories on Rest Days? | GetMacros
item.description: You can keep calories the same on rest days or cycle them around training. Compare both approaches while keeping recovery and your weekly goal in view.

item.title: Calories vs. Macros: What Matters More? | GetMacros
item.description: Calories vs. macros: learn which matters for weight change, muscle, fullness and performance—and how to set priorities without tracking everything.

item.title: Can You Build Muscle in a Calorie Deficit? | GetMacros
item.description: Muscle gain in a calorie deficit is possible for some people, but energy deficiency makes it harder. See who is most likely to progress and what matters.

item.title: What do carbs do in your body? | GetMacros
item.description: Carbohydrates provide energy. Foods such as oats, rice, potatoes, fruit and beans can also bring fiber, vitamins and minerals to your meals.

item.title: Healthy CAVA Orders: Bowls, Calories & Protein | GetMacros
item.description: Compare all 4 tracked CAVA items by calories, protein, fiber and sodium. Harissa Avocado bowl leads on protein at 42 g.

item.title: Healthy Chick-fil-A Options: High-Protein Meals | GetMacros
item.description: Compare all 11 tracked Chick-fil-A items by calories, protein, fiber and sodium. Top protein 104 g; lightest substantial order 130 calories.

item.title: Healthy Chipotle Orders: Calories & Protein | GetMacros
item.description: Compare all 6 tracked Chipotle items by calories, protein, fiber and sodium. Chicken Bowl with white rice and black beans leads on protein at 48 g.

item.title: Cutting, bulking or maintenance: what do they mean? | GetMacros
item.description: Cutting means eating for weight loss. Bulking means eating to support weight gain and muscle building. Maintenance means keeping weight broadly steady.

item.title: Does Creatine Cause Hair Loss? | GetMacros
item.description: Does creatine cause hair loss? See what the 2009 DHT study found, what the 2025 hair-follicle trial added and what remains uncertain.

item.title: Healthy Dunkin' Breakfast: Calories & Protein | GetMacros
item.description: Compare all 4 tracked Dunkin’ items by calories, protein, fiber and sodium. Sourdough Breakfast Sandwich leads on protein at 30 g.

item.title: What does fat do in your body? | GetMacros
item.description: Fat provides energy, essential fatty acids and help absorbing vitamins A, D, E and K. Both the type and amount matter.

item.title: Healthy Fast Food: Compare Calories & Protein | GetMacros
item.description: Compare healthy fast-food options by restaurant, calories, protein, fiber and sodium. Explore menu guides and find meals for your goals.

item.title: 25 High-Protein Foods: Compare Servings & Calories | GetMacros
item.description: Compare 25 high-protein foods by protein per serving and per 100 calories, including meat, fish, dairy and plant-based choices.

item.title: How many calories should I eat a day? | GetMacros
item.description: There is no single calorie target for everyone. Your body size, age, activity and goal help estimate a starting point.

item.title: How much fiber do you need per day? | GetMacros
item.description: Fiber helps with digestion and can support heart health. Beans, whole grains, fruit, vegetables, nuts and seeds are practical ways to get more.

item.title: How Much Protein Can Your Body Absorb at Once? | GetMacros
item.description: Your body does not waste protein after 30 grams. Learn the difference between protein absorption, muscle protein synthesis and practical meal distribution.

item.title: How much protein do you need per day? | GetMacros
item.description: Your protein needs depend on your body size, training and health. Use these ranges as a starting point, then choose foods that make the target practical.
